title: Check a path number
summary: Flask: Check a path number. Try /double/cat and observe 404.
introduction: The int converter accepts a whole-number path value. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Check a path number with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Check a path number

blocks.text: The int converter accepts 4 and gives the view an integer. The result is 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A route converter decides whether the route matches before the function runs.
